answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 237 Country: India Title: Can a women pray in clothes that she wore during her haidh if there are no physical impurities on them? Question: Can a women pray in clothes that she wore during her haidh if there are no physical impurities on them? Answer ID: 237 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 412/J) Yes, she can pray in the clothes that she wore during her menses provided they are tahir (clean and pure). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
